answer.rationale: Launch a tightly targeted, time-bounded promotional-pricing response for price-sensitive SMB accounts. Existing durable evidence supports acquisition and revenue lift in this segment, while the current competitor cut and doubled price-related churn conversations make price intervention the most directly responsive option. Use guardrails on discount depth, duration, eligibility, and post-promotion retention/expansion because the archived summary does not quantify long-term margin, retention, or willingness-to-pay effects.
